name: Failure Shake
summary: Validation failed: one horizontal damped shake (+8, −6, +4, −2 pt, at rest again in 0.40 s) with the .error haptic on the first frame, and an optional destructive tint for the length of the shake. Only for a real rejection, never to draw attention.

accessibility.reduceMotion: no translation; opacity dips 1 → 0.6 → 1 over 0.2 s; same .error haptic at t = 0, same tint
accessibility.voiceOver: no strings of its own; announce the error from the control you own

sources: Apple, Human Interface Guidelines: Playing haptics (notification feedback: Error)
Apple, Human Interface Guidelines: SF Symbols, Animations: Wiggle (symbolEffect(.wiggle), iOS 18), the system's own one-line shake, for symbols only
macOS login window: a rejected password shakes side to side (platform convention)
SmoothUI, Unlock Face ID (Eduardo Calvo, MIT): failure = destructive red + one shake; no shake under reduced motion

states.motion: at rest in the host's own styling; trigger going back to false is silent

damped horizontal sine, +8 → −6 → +4 → −2 → 0 pt (peaks at 24, 82, 151, 247 ms), ease-out over duration (0.40 s); tint, if set, from the first frame; false → true again restarts from the first swing. Reduce Motion: no translation, opacity 1 → 0.6 → 1 over 0.2 s
states.haptic: .error at t = 0 (three transients over 120 ms), before any visual work: failure never waits

states.motion: at rest; tint eases back over 0.15 s. A shake whose trigger was reset mid-way lands in idle instead
